summary: The victim signed a malicious ERC20 token approval on a phishing website that granted an attacker permission to spend USDT from the wallet. The attacker used the approval to drain 999999 USDT through multiple transactions without compromising the private key or recovery phrase.
user_mistake: Approved an unverified smart contract on a phishing website.
prevention: Review spender permissions before approving transactions / Revoke unnecessary token approvals regularly
